warnings: FOOTING MARK = PILE COUNT. F1, F3, F6, F8, F10, F12 and F16 each carry exactly that many pile symbols in the drawing (F3 is a triangular cap with 3 piles, F6 a 2x3 rectangle, F16 a 4x4 square, and so on). pile_count is therefore parsed from the mark and cross-checked against the drawn symbols, not assumed.

RESOLVED -- F16 IS CORRECT, F18 IS A TYPO. This plan uses F16 at C-2 (the most heavily loaded interior column) while S-01's index calls the fourth enlargement sheet 'ขยายฐานรากเสาเข็ม F18'. S-10 (PNG 43) settles it: the drawing there is titled F16, its section arrows read 16-16 and its note says 16 piles -- only the title-block field says F18. So the index and title block carry the typo and the plan is right.

Footing layout is NOT a full 4 x 4. Row D and row C are complete (four each), row B has four, and row A has only two on-grid footings (A-1 and A-2). REWRITTEN AFTER HIGH-ZOOM RE-VERIFICATION 2026-07-27 (recording a reversal): the earlier version of this warning claimed TWO F1 pads sit off-grid, located by the 1.20/0.80 and 1.60 dimensions. Wrong on both counts. Only ONE F1 is off-grid -- the one below B-3 (recorded as ~A-3), whose centre sits on the line 1.20 m below B / 0.80 m above A that the left-edge 1.20/0.80 sub-chain defines (verified by pixel measurement, 158 px/m at this scan). The other F1 sits exactly ON B-4. The 1.60 dimension does not locate any footing -- it is the length of the GB1X ground-beam stub running south from B-4.
Column (ตอม่อ) marks are C1, C2 and C3 -- three sizes, with C3 only under the F16 footing at C-2. The column schedule is on S-11 (PNG 44).

Ground beams GB1 and GB1X are both set at -0.50 m. REWRITTEN 2026-07-27 (recording a reversal): the earlier version said 'only two are drawn' and labelled the vertical C-4 to B-4 run as GB1X. High-zoom re-read shows THREE segments in the bottom-right corner: GB1 horizontal B-3 to B-4, GB1 vertical C-4 to B-4 (its rotated label clearly reads GB1, not GB1X), and GB1X as a short 1.60 m stub continuing south of B-4 to the free end the 1.60 dimension locates. The main ground-floor beam layout is on S-03.
No break lines anywhere on this sheet -- the full 13.00 x 11.00 m building fits at 1:100.
